name: AI build bridge
author: Brett
description: Turns a note tagged #build or a spoken "build …" into a build request for Brett's Build Orchestrator (mode ai.build-request on the axHub session host). Every request waits for Brett's approval through axHub's approval flow (approval link shown here + push in the AXHub app), polled every 15 s for the first 10 tries, then every minute. Never builds or edits code itself. Admins only (UAC).

hostActions.axnotes.notes.saved: the app dispatches it after saving a note (payload = the note JSON); notes tagged #build become requests
hostActions.ai-build-bridge.finished: dispatched by this plugin when the orchestrator reports a build done (payload {requestId, title, status, buildId?, summary?})
